tldr: The US marked the 25th anniversary of the September 11th attacks with solemn remembrance ceremonies.
US consumer prices remained elevated in August, with inflation holding steady at 3.4% annually, largely due to increased energy costs driven by the ongoing conflict with Iran.
August was confirmed as the hottest month on record globally, continuing a trend of record-breaking temperatures.

market.why: The S&P 500 and Nasdaq Composite saw declines as persistent inflation, driven partly by the Iran conflict and rising energy costs, may influence future Federal Reserve monetary policy. The VIX, a measure of expected stock volatility, increased.

yield_10y.why: The 10-year Treasury yield rose, reflecting concerns about sustained inflation. Stubbornly high consumer prices in August, influenced by energy costs from the Iran conflict, suggest a potential need for tighter monetary policy, which typically pushes yields higher.

vix.why: The VIX increased, indicating a rise in anticipated market volatility. This sentiment may be linked to ongoing inflation concerns and the geopolitical impact of the Iran conflict, creating uncertainty for investors.

watchlist.read: Mid-range - 22% of the way up its 1-month band. Big session: down 8.0% in a day.

mortgage.why: The 30-year fixed mortgage rate saw a slight increase. Mortgage rates tend to track the direction of Treasury yields, and recent inflation data, coupled with the ongoing conflict impacting energy prices, has contributed to upward pressure on yields.

policy_upcoming.what_happened: This document contains final regulations regarding the deduction for certain taxpayers for an amount up to $10,000 of qualified passenger vehicle loan interest.
policy_upcoming.effect: You can deduct up to $10,000 of qualified passenger vehicle loan interest.

policy_upcoming.what_happened: A Utah bill modifies provisions related to the property tax exemption process.
policy_upcoming.effect: Once you own a home, you will have deadlines for filing an application for a property tax exemption with the county board of equalization and for the board to render a decision.

policy_upcoming.what_happened: A bill amends requirements for health insurance preauthorization in Utah.
policy_upcoming.effect: Your health insurer must make an authorization or adverse preauthorization determination within a defined maximum time.

policy_week.effect: You can deduct up to $10,000 of qualified passenger vehicle loan interest.

tech.summary: Meta is altering its AI chatbot's suggestion prompts after a viral incident where the AI asked invasive questions about a user's daughters, acknowledging the feature "missed the mark" and should not have sought such personal information.
A new analysis suggests that while RTK claims cost savings for AI coding, independent benchmarks indicate otherwise, questioning the actual financial benefits of the technology.
Researchers have developed a method to measure the "sloppiness" of code, exploring the concept of code quality in an era where AI is increasingly involved in software development.

world.summary: Remembrance ceremonies were held across the United States to honor the victims of the September 11th attacks, marking 25 years since the tragic events.
The Houthi movement has reportedly taken control of a key island in the Red Sea, raising concerns about disruptions to global shipping routes and vital oil choke points.

US consumer prices in August remained unchanged year-over-year at 3.4%, with core inflation rising to 2.4%. The persistent inflation was largely attributed to higher energy costs stemming from the ongoing conflict with Iran.
August was confirmed as the hottest month ever recorded globally, with scientists attributing the heat surge primarily to human-caused climate change.

us.summary: The United States observed the 25th anniversary of the September 11th attacks with commemorations at various sites, reflecting on the lives lost and the enduring impact of the events.
The Trump administration has decided to allow Temporary Protected Status (TPS) for Salvadorans to continue for now, but has not yet specified if it will be extended in the future.

A bipartisan group of US lawmakers has urged a secretive British court to increase transparency regarding its handling of a case involving Apple and encrypted data, warning that secrecy strains US-UK relations.

science.summary: August shattered global heat records, making it the hottest month ever measured, with scientists pointing to human-caused climate change as the primary driver.
A case in Louisiana is challenging telehealth abortion access, raising legal questions about the provision of abortion pills via remote consultations.
